newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura Sec falls on expected earnings loss.
newsitem.headline: Nomura Sec falls on expected earnings loss.

text.p: Shares of Nomura Securities Co Ltd dropped in Friday morning trade, depressed by Thursday's announcement that the firm was expected to post earnings losses for the first half of 1996/97, traders said.
The share price was down 30 yen to 1,950 at 0118 GMT. Volume was 1.317 million shares.
After the market closed on Thursday, Nomura Securities announced it would provide financial support worth 371 billion yen to its non-bank affiliate Nomura Finance Co.

Nomura also said that it would post special losses of 371 billion yen for the first half of the current business year ending September 30, which would probably result in earnings losses for the period.
